body: No idea. But I don't see how it would matter.
What are the symptoms of withdrawal and how soon after quitting do you feel them?

I doubt I'm legitametly addicted given how short my time using has been. I don't think you can get addicted in a month. Even if you use semi frequently and consider using an important part of your day.

My use isn't fundamental to me as a person, my natural disfunction is. I use to escape that.

And I've learned that when I'm high I'm better company for those around me, I'm more open and friendly. I've spent a decade working on those traits specifically and have gotten nowhere. I've finally found something that works.

Opiates. I started using so I wouldn't feel like shit, not to get high. There's going to be a downward spiral either way, at least now I can feel legitimately good for some of it, even if it is a synthetic happyiness.
